stability: Anything not listed here — everything under _plan/, _records/ and takes/ — is internal and may change without notice. cues.json/placed.json/drops.json are the pipeline's working registers; the ledger is the reviewer-facing rollup of all three.

cue-ledger.description: The reviewer's artifact: every cue and unmet obligation with TWO independent axes (importance: why it must exist; compliance: what shipping it costs) and a DERIVED disposition — the ship/review line is customer policy, re-derivable without a re-run.

windows.description: The narration windows with duties (scene entry / prelude / anticipatory / reveal), budgets, and evidence pointers — the plan the script was written against.

gaps.description: Unserved obligations with named causes: beats no cue conveys, high-necessity orientation breaks no cue serves, scenes never grounded. Reviewer-accepted absences (decisions_s3uri) are filtered out.

example.reason: no usable silence within the search horizon

srt.description: The placed cues as SubRip captions ([AD] prefixed), timed to the fitted takes.

vtt.description: The placed cues as WebVTT, same timing as the srt.

dapt.description: W3C DAPT (Dubbing and Audio description Profile of TTML2) script — the interchange format professional post tooling ingests; one audioDescription Script Event per placed cue.

review.description: Single-file review page over the LEDGER (the rows that did not ship are the point), with per-cue audio pointers.

manifest.description: Run header: inputs, sung_vocal_policy, shipped cue count, gap count, and the labeled output uris.

usage.description: Aggregated bedrock cost/tokens across every submission (cost_is_complete propagated from the producer) plus the tts submission count.

render-manifest.description: Everything a renderer needs to produce the fitted takes or the full accessible mix: per-take wav uri + placement (at) + tempo, plus the af_chain. Chain media-processing's process_media with an ad_mix output group pointing here to get the ducked, loudness-normalized mix wav.
